scope: Immutable Git-object review and in-memory Python compilation only. No script execution, downloads, remote publication, tracked edits or build output.

compile.method: compile(source_bytes, repository_path, exec, dont_inherit=True); no pyc generated

documented_provenance.provenance_checks: Pinned identifiers and declared hashes are internally consistent with the roadmap. Source bytes, published revision, Hunspell performance/token statistics, and external licence/platform-policy claims were not independently fetched or verified in this review.

concrete_observations.observation: The output directory is allowed to exist, then its entire path is passed to upload_folder without an allowlist or empty-directory check. The script writes/verifies only its named payloads and manifest; it does not enforce that an existing output directory contains only those files.
concrete_observations.implication: A reused output directory can carry extra content outside the declared manifest. Use a fresh dedicated output directory for the documented workflow, or enforce membership before a later publisher change. This helper was not executed during this integration review.

concrete_observations.observation: The builder emits eight manifest-listed payloads (six upstream files, licence text and card) plus manifest.json itself: nine output files. The roadmap says all eight files were read back; the code separately reads back the manifest as a ninth file.
concrete_observations.implication: Describe eight payload files plus the manifest when reporting bundle counts.

acceptance_limits: The incoming delta does not implement or enable Arabic proofing in the application.
Syntax compilation does not qualify downloads, byte verification against upstream, publication, licence conclusions, Hunspell linguistic quality or application integration.
